items.subject: Nacre gateway
items.text: The Nacre gateway maintenance window starts at 02:40 UTC every Tuesday.

items.subject: E42 pump fault
items.rule: For an E42 pump fault, measure inlet pressure first. If it is below 4 bar, restore inlet pressure and retest; do not replace the pump. If pressure is at least 4 bar and E42 persists after retesting, replace the pump.
